classification_scope: Eligibility for the unified desk; package-local runtime status is stated separately in notes.

classifications.accepted: Eligible as an evidence or market-data input with its stated provenance; acceptance never turns a model annotation into a fact.
classifications.provisional: May be inspected or fixture-tested but cannot drive a production decision until its named gate passes.
classifications.quarantined: Retained for audit only and excluded from every unified projection by default.
classifications.archive-only: Historical, backup, scratch, browser-state, experiment, or retired output; never a unified runtime input.
